This is a very simple swift tool that allows a swiftop engineer to retrieve information about an account that is located on the storage node. One calls the tool with a given db file as it is stored on the storage node system. It will then return several information about that account such as;

- Account
- Account hash
- Created timestamp
- Put timestamp
- Delete timestamp
- Container Count
- Object count
- Bytes used
- Chexor
- ID
- User Metadata
- Ring Location

-h, --help
Shows the help message and exit
-d SWIFT_DIR, --swift-dir=SWIFT_DIR
Pass location of swift configuration file if different from the default location /etc/swift
More documentation about OpenStack Swift can be found at https://docs.openstack.org/swift/latest/
